questions.stem: What is the key difference between Data Conversion and Data Transformation?
options: Data Conversion applies only to numbers, Data Transformation only to text
In Data Conversion the data is not changed, whereas in Data Transformation data can be changed based on business requirements
Data Conversion is done by business users, Data Transformation by machines
Data Conversion is always reversible, Data Transformation never
There is no difference; the terms are interchangeable
questions.explanation: In Data Conversion the data itself is not changed, whereas Data Transformation can change data according to business requirements for decision making.

questions.stem: Which of the following is given as a basic example of Data Conversion?
options: Converting weather data from Celsius to Fahrenheit
Aggregating daily data into monthly totals
questions.explanation: Converting weather data between Celsius and Fahrenheit, or unifying all date formats, are basic examples of Data Conversion.

questions.stem: Why is it better to convert a field that contains only numbers from a string data type to a number data type?
options: Because processing is much faster on a number data type than on a string
Because strings cannot be stored in databases
Because it reduces the number of rows
questions.explanation: Processing is much faster on a number data type compared with a string, so numeric-only fields should be converted.

questions.stem: A field holding predefined values such as Male/Female or Yes/No is stored as varchar; to which data type is it better converted?
questions.explanation: Fields with predefined values are better converted to char, because processing is much faster on char than on varchar or varchar2.

questions.stem: In the Big Data era, roughly what proportion of datasets are described as semi-structured or unstructured?
questions.explanation: In the new era of Big Data, over 90% of datasets are semi-structured or unstructured, which is why converting and standardising them is so important.

questions.stem: What should happen to semi-structured and unstructured data before it can be cleaned, cleansed or scrubbed?
options: It should be converted or standardised
It should be loaded straight into reports
It should be deleted if older than a year
questions.explanation: It is of utmost importance to convert or standardise semi-structured and unstructured data before it can be cleaned, cleansed or scrubbed.

questions.stem: What does Data Governance contribute to Data Conversion?
options: It replaces the need for Data Quality
It adds policies to make sure data is standardised
It converts unstructured data into images
questions.explanation: Data Governance adds policies to make sure data is standardised.

questions.stem: Which of the following is NOT listed as a use of Data Conversion?
options: Changing data values according to business decisions
Standardising different formats into one unified format
Converting one format into different formats
Converting one data model to another for business ease of use
Converting data into reporting and dashboard formats
questions.explanation: Changing data values for business decisions is Data Transformation; Data Conversion covers format, model and presentation conversions without changing the data.

questions.stem: Which activity is said to produce much better and faster results once data has been standardised?
questions.explanation: Data Profiling produces much better and faster results if the data has been standardised, as do ETL, ELT and Data Quality.

questions.stem: Converting images, PDFs, video or audio into semi-structured or structured file formats is an example of what?
questions.explanation: Conversion of unstructured content such as images, PDFs, video and audio into semi-structured or structured formats is one of the listed examples of Data Conversion.
